description: This Java abstract class 'AbstractLoanItemReader' provides a template for reading Loan objects within a batch processing context. It implements the ItemReader interface, retrieving Loan entities by IDs stored in a queue, and handles exceptions specific to loan data access. It also includes a method to mark the step as completed after execution.

classes.name: AbstractLoanItemReader
classes.description: An abstract class that implements 'ItemReader' for reading 'Loan' objects by their IDs. It manages a queue of loan IDs and fetches corresponding 'Loan' entities from the repository, handling exceptions specific to loan reading processes.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves a loan ID from the queue and attempts to fetch the corresponding Loan entity from the repository. Throws a 'LoanReadException' if an error occurs during retrieval. Returns null if no more data is available.

methods.name: afterStep
methods.description: Marks the batch step as completed after execution by returning 'ExitStatus.COMPLETED'.
